title: Evaluation case
description: One line of eval/cases.jsonl. `expected_priority` is null until a human labels the case against docs/priority-policy.md; the eval script reports unlabeled cases separately and never guesses a label.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the file.

text.description: Ticket text exactly as it would be sent to the API.

expected_priority.description: Human-assigned label, or null if not yet labeled.

sentiment_override.description: Optional. Bypasses the sentiment model so a case is deterministic (e.g. to hold sentiment constant). Without it the eval runs the real model.

notes.description: Why this case is in the set.
